canonical_definition:
What it is. Papers treat Amazon Books as an Amazon dataset centered on products in the Books category, with user-item interactions and product metadata. In the available definition, it is described as being used to evaluate recommendation performance, and no versions or subsets are described.

What it is claimed to measure. The only explicit measurement claim in the available material is that papers use Amazon Books for evaluating recommendation performance. No construct is linked to it, and no behavioral indicator is linked to it, so the recorded claims do not converge on any named construct beyond that general evaluation use.

Space of uses. The available paper positions Amazon Books as an evaluation dataset rather than describing it alongside other instruments. No other measurement instrument is linked to it in the recorded relationships.
papers: Catastrophic Failure of LLM Unlearning via Quantization
Language Representations Can be What Recommenders Need: Findings and Potentials
Learning Dynamics in Continual Pre-Training for Large Language Models

definitions.text: An Amazon dataset containing user-item interactions and metadata for products in the 'Books' category, used for evaluating recommendation performance.
definitions.paper: Language Representations Can be What Recommenders Need: Findings and Potentials
